cases.name: testLogicalExpressionUnchanged
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    IF   a   =   abap_false  AND  b   >    3
    OR   a   =   abap_true   AND  b  <=   10.
      " do something
    ELSEIF  a  =  abap_true    AND  b   >   3
       AND  a  =  abap_false   AND  b  <=  10.
      " do something else
    ENDIF.

    WHILE   a  =  abap_true
       OR   b  =  abap_false.
      " do something
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.

       AND  a  =  abap_false   AND  b  <=  10.
      " do something else
    ENDIF.

    WHILE   a  =  abap_true
       OR   b  =  abap_false.
      " do something
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testProcessAcrossWhenSections
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_value.
      WHEN 1.         " case 1
        ls_struc-comp1            =   lv_any_value.
      WHEN 2.         " case 2
        ls_struc-component2       =   lv_other_value.
      WHEN 3.         " case 3
        ls_struc-long_component   =   lv_third_value.
      WHEN OTHERS.    " default
        ls_struc-comp4            =   lv_default_value.
    ENDCASE.

    CASE lv_second_value.
      WHEN 1.         " case 1
        ls_struc-comp1            =   lv_any_value.
      WHEN OTHERS.    " default
        ls_struc-component2       =   lv_default_value.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_value.
      WHEN 1.      " case 1
        ls_struc-comp1          = lv_any_value.
      WHEN 2.      " case 2
        ls_struc-component2     = lv_other_value.
      WHEN 3.      " case 3
        ls_struc-long_component = lv_third_value.
      WHEN OTHERS. " default
        ls_struc-comp4          = lv_default_value.
    ENDCASE.

    CASE lv_second_value.
      WHEN 1.      " case 1
        ls_struc-comp1      = lv_any_value.
      WHEN OTHERS. " default
        ls_struc-component2 = lv_default_value.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
